record.dic_text:
04308 Matred {mat-rade'}

源自 02956; 陰性專有名詞

AV - Matred 2; 2

瑪特列= "往前推進"
1) 米薩合的女兒是米希他別的母親，巴烏城哈大(或哈達)的妻子，哈大是以東王 (#創36:39;代上 1:50|)
record.edic_text:
04308 Matred {mat-rade'}

from 02956;; n pr f

AV - Matred 2; 2

Matred = "pushing forward"
1) daughter of Mezahab and mother of Mehetabel, the wife of Hadar
   (Hadad) of Pau, king of Edom
